# Changelog

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Connects to Lark's official remote MCP server at `https://mcp.larksuite.com/mcp` over MCP OAuth, with the authorization server discovered from the server URL at connect time.
- Covers Lark Suite, the international product. China-region Feishu runs a separate server at `https://mcp.feishu.cn/mcp` and is not included.
- Logo: Lark's official bird mark as published by Lark Technologies Pte. Ltd. on the `larksuite` GitHub organization, 256×256 PNG.
